claims.statement: The mobile chat fragment locates the Copilot entry icon at the lower-right but explicitly says it is absent on some pages and suggests another page when missing. Absence on one page does not by itself prove revoked access or a service failure.
The IDE caveat says extensions may override the user's chosen model. A selection record alone therefore cannot certify the model that actually generated a response.

The IDE caveat warns that experimental prerelease models may interact incorrectly with filters, specifically including public-code-match blocking. Configured blocking is not proof of effective filtering and cannot serve as rights clearance.

The broader agent-instruction support label names AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md as example instruction-file forms. It is an embedded list label, not evidence that every Copilot surface supports all three, loads them or applies any specific precedence.

The narrower agent-instruction label names only AGENTS.md. This distinction from the broader three-file label must be preserved; importing the label does not authorize executing instructions found in upstream files.

The organization instruction label identifies organization-level support without specifying applicability, permissions, precedence, inheritance or enforcement; surrounding product documentation remains necessary.

The path-specific label uses the .github/instructions/**/*.instructions.md pattern to describe instruction files. File existence or matching that naming convention does not establish that instructions are loaded, correctly scoped or enforced.
